messages:
alex_crane: Heads-up — customer on v0.18 reports intermittent 504s and what looks like duplicate POSTs (billing duplicate events). They say retries are replaying non-idempotent requests. Raising here to triage.

maria_lopez: Do we have logs / request IDs? Are they using the default http.Client or a custom transport?

alex_crane: Attached snippets from customer and our server logs. They include our X-Request-ID header but the server shows the same payload processed twice. Using go1.20, go-sdk v0.18. Example client usage they provided:

```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
defer cancel()
client := &http.Client{
    Transport: &http.Transport{
        MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 100,
        IdleConnTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
    },
}
req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/run", bytes.NewReader(payload))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer ...")
resp, err := client.Do(req)
// they rely on our SDK retry logic on network errors
```

jamal: Important detail: customer uses our SDK which wraps do/retry logic. If the context deadline triggers and underlying transport returns EOF or connection reset, our retryer may re-issue the POST. For non-idempotent endpoints we should prevent automatic retries unless server signals safe to retry.

sam_kapoor: Can you paste the server-side log lines around the duplicate processing? Curious if requests have identical X-Request-ID or different ones.

alex_crane: Server shows two distinct request IDs on arrival but identical payload and headers except our tracing header was preserved. So it looks like two TCP connections submitted the same body. Customer reproduction steps: they run a load test loop with 1s timeout, sometimes client cancels, then SDK retries and server still processes both.

support-bot: Ticket created: TICKET-5234 — escalation to eng (priority P1) :rotating_light:

eng-golang: Quick triage notes:
- Cause hypothesis: transport half-closed or early cancel allowed the request body to be re-sent by retry layer. If the original request actually reached server but client saw a network error, retryer fires and replay happens.
- Known problematic config: keeping keepalives + short ctx deadlines + default retry policy for non-idempotent POSTs.

maria_lopez: Workarounds for customer while we fix:
1) Avoid transparent retries for POSTs: set RetryPolicy to never retry on methods != GET/HEAD or when body present.
2) Make requests idempotent on client side (add Idempotency-Key header) so server can dedupe.
3) Bump context timeout so it doesn't cancel in-flight frequently.
4) As a transport tweak: set Transport.DisableKeepAlives = true or set ResponseHeaderTimeout to lower value to fail fast on half-closed sockets.

alex_crane: I suggested Idempotency-Key and disabling retries for POSTs. Customer tried adding Idempotency-Key and saw duplicates go away in quick test. They want a patch to SDK to avoid this class of bug.

jamal: Repro steps I've run locally:
```bash
# simple loop to reproduce cancel+retry behavior
for i in {1..100}; do 
  go run repro/main.go || true &
  sleep 0.1
done
# repro repo: github.com/redwood/repro-go-post-replay (private)
```
Logs show sometimes two server accepts within milliseconds.

eng-golang: Plan:
- Short-term: document clear guidance (no automatic retries for POST unless Idempotency-Key). Add a prominent note in the Go SDK README.
- Fix: change default retry behavior in go-sdk v0.21 to be conservative (no retry on POST without idempotency). Add opt-in RetryOnNetworkFailure for advanced users.
- Backport: consider patch to v0.18 branch if customer on locked version but severe billing impact.

sam_kapoor: Also adding tests for transport+ctx cancel combos (integration with net/http and real TCP). We saw flaky behavior with IdleConnTimeout short values under load.

maria_lopez: Action items assigned:
- alex_crane: confirm with customer whether they can upgrade to v0.21 when released or use Idempotency-Key now.
- eng-golang: PR to change default retry policy + add docs and example.
- support: monitor TICKET-5234 and keep customer updated.

alex_crane: Customer switched to Idempotency-Key temporarily and reported no duplicates in 24h smoke. We'll keep this thread open until patch release. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
